claim: Mentra App launcher repair for off-screen Home apps and hidden developer shortcut
summary: MentraOS PR #4943 reports that Add to Home from All Apps could save drawer coordinates and displace existing Home apps off-screen when no saved layout existed; the developer shortcut also ignored its launcher visibility setting. Merged October 24 03:10 UTC, with 149 upstream tests. The PR says device coverage for exact Add to Home regression remains absent. No claim of erased apps or independently verified consumer rollout.
